headline: No Dogs in Space is back to feed your need for obsessive music history
summary: Popular music history podcast "No Dogs in Space" is returning for its fourth season. The show, hosted by Carolina Hidalgo and Marcus Parks, focuses on "Punk 2.0." This marks its comeback after a two-year break, to the delight of fans.

headline: No one is surprised that Nvidia's Jensen Huang thinks AI fears are overblown
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang claims there's "0% chance" of AI being the end of humanity. His comments, made in a CBS interview, aren't surprising given his financial interest in AI. His optimistic view contrasts with concerns from many long-term AI researchers.

headline: Kojima Productions disputes reports the studio is in trouble
summary: Kojima Productions denies rumors of internal issues following Sony dropping "Physint." Hideo Kojima's latest title will now be released on Xbox instead of PlayStation. Reports suggested Sony's decision was due to missed deadlines and budget concerns.

headline: Trump now says he wants to form an 'AI Force'
summary: Donald Trump announced plans via Truth Social to establish an "AI Force." He intends to appoint an "AI czar" to lead this new initiative. Trump vowed his administration would not impede AI development, despite calls for caution.

headline: Here's Everything You Need to Know About Mighty Mike Plays and the $118,000 He Allegedly Cost His Dad
summary: Mighty Mike Plays, a Minecraft YouTuber, has gone viral across the internet. The controversy centers on an alleged $118,000 bill linked to his activities. AI-generated T-shirt designs are also part of the internet's fascination with the story.

headline: Silent Hill: Townfall Review
summary: Silent Hill: Townfall has received a positive review. The game is described as a "welcome shot in the arm" for the series. It successfully revitalizes the long-running Silent Hill franchise.

headline: Lanterns Season 1, Episode 6 Review & Recap
summary: Lanterns Season 1, Episode 6, has been reviewed. The episode struggles, despite returning to the present day storyline. It reportedly fails to maintain its narrative momentum, impacting the series.

headline: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story Review
summary: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story has been reviewed. The show attempts to offer commentary on female rage. However, it's criticized for not fully committing to its message.

headline: Young people aren't snowflakes - mental distress is rising, says head of official review
summary: An official review's head, Prof. Peter Fonagy, states young people face rising mental distress. He asserts that being young today is significantly more difficult than in the past. Fonagy challenges the "snowflake" stereotype, linking issues to societal pressures.

headline: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on
summary: German Chancellor Merz called recent state election results a "disaster" for his CDU party. Exit polls show damaging losses for the centre-right party in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin. Despite the setback, Merz has vowed to remain in his leadership role.

headline: Oxford grooming gang survivors tell BBC 'hundreds' of abusers still free
summary: Survivors of the Oxford grooming gang claim "hundreds" of abusers are still free. They state these men, who abused them as underage girls, remain in the city. The BBC report highlights ongoing concerns regarding justice for victims.

headline: Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial
summary: Russia's recent elections concluded with few unexpected outcomes. The Kremlin's utilization of these results will be critical, according to a BBC analyst. Vladimir Putin is expected to frame the outcome as public support for the Ukraine operation.
